items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: a base hit was made by King and the prodigal son made a home run

ctx.x: If you brought a kid to the ball game and it's rainin', who's playin'. That's like the guy saying, "Who's on

first," See that guy doing that gag? "Who's on first?" But the baseball is the thing. You know where baseball was invented, dontcha? Huh? In the Garden of Eden. Eve stole first, Adam took second, St. Peter empired the game, Rebecca went to the world with the pitcher, while Ruth was in the field, won fame, (inaudible) was struck out by David base, a base hit was made by King and the prodigal son made a home run and Noah gave out checks for rain. That's how the ball game started.
